steps.title: Compile CUDA kernel families
steps.validation: Re-run python3 scripts/verify_kernel_benchmarks.py and confirm torch_device=cuda in the report.

steps.title: Run Triton kernels on CUDA
steps.validation: Refresh autotune records and verify selected configs after GPU timings are present.

steps.title: Build and profile CUTLASS/CuTe tensor-core GEMM
steps.validation: GPU host should provide CUTLASS/CuTe build evidence, MMA instruction evidence, cuBLAS/Triton comparisons, and profiler counters.

steps.title: Profile persistent Triton/CUDA kernels
steps.validation: GPU host should capture occupancy, launch amortization, register pressure, shared memory, L2 reuse, and DRAM-byte counters for persistent versus non-persistent baselines.

steps.title: Profile GPU parallel primitives
steps.validation: GPU host should capture DRAM bytes, shared-memory bank conflicts, atomics, synchronization depth, occupancy, and stable-order correctness for primitive kernels.

steps.title: Build and validate PyTorch custom extension
steps.validation: Confirm compiled_extension_status changes from source-only to cuda-ready.

steps.title: Run tiny transformer integration on GPU-backed operators
steps.validation: Verify model cases pass and regression ledger captures tokens_per_second from GPU-backed runs.

steps.title: Replay or import vLLM-style serving traces
steps.validation: Replace deterministic timing constants with server trace measurements using the same schema.

steps.title: Profile FlashAttention-to-vLLM serving stack
steps.validation: GPU-host run should replace local stack estimates with FlashAttention kernel counters and prefill/decode serving traces.

steps.title: Profile FlashAttention backward training kernels
steps.validation: GPU host should capture dQ/dK/dV gradient correctness, DRAM bytes, occupancy, register pressure, shared memory, exp recompute cost, and training-step timeline evidence.

steps.title: Profile sparse and ragged attention kernels
steps.validation: GPU host should capture metadata build cost, sparse QK/PV DRAM bytes, branch efficiency, warp execution efficiency, load balance, occupancy, metadata cache hit rate, and numerical error.

steps.title: Profile fused LLM training kernels
steps.validation: GPU host should capture launch count, DRAM bytes, occupancy, register pressure, reduction stability, optimizer-state bandwidth, and max error for fused training kernels.

steps.title: Profile speculative decoding serving scheduler
steps.validation: GPU host or Colab should capture acceptance rate, target verification latency, wasted draft tokens, rollback count, KV commit telemetry, TTFT, TPOT, throughput, and profiler timelines.

steps.title: Capture Nsight and rocprof evidence
steps.validation: Profiler rows should classify memory bandwidth, tensor-core compute, launch overhead, and host/device transfer.

steps.title: Compile ROCm/HIP portability path
steps.validation: ROCm host should move the HIP project from source-only to measured runtime evidence.

steps.title: Run distributed collective tests
steps.validation: Capture NCCL/RCCL/NVSHMEM bandwidth, collective algorithm, rank-count, and communication-overlap measurements on a multi-GPU host.

steps.title: Profile distributed training optimizer stacks
steps.validation: Measure FSDP/ZeRO step time, memory peak, reduce-scatter/all-gather overlap, and pipeline bubble behavior on a multi-GPU training host.

steps.title: Refresh full GPU-host regression ledger
steps.validation: Final GPU-host run should have zero regression failures, a collected GPU-run import, and fewer source-ready fallback profiles.
